acceptanceCriteria: the WQO-V0-004 subtest cannot observe transient Git lock files: the fixture disables auto-maintenance (maintenance.auto=false, gc.auto=0) or the manifest excludes transient .git lock files, and the test passes repeatedly under -count=20 with parallel load
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from PR #219 CI run 36181215001 (go-product). materializationManifest (cmd/corvint/work_observe_test.go:45) walks the fixture root including .git and failed with 'open .../.git/objects/maintenance.lock: no such file or directory': a detached Git auto-maintenance created and removed the lock during the walk. The failure is unrelated to the PR's change; the job was rerun.

completion.reason: Fixed in adafe83f (hermetic work fixture, PR 243); dispositions recorded in 60438f03. Contained in the 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate 94ca556f52c0349c0a48e0c3a3274f8a0b5e6db3 on origin/main. Owner-approved closure 2026-09-27.

title: TestObserveWorkUsesOnlyTargetMaterialization races Git auto-maintenance lock files
